notes:
Run each prompt in a fresh agent session WITH the skill installed, against a WRITABLE COPY of the scenario fixture (copy evals/fixtures/phasewave/<scenario>/ into a fresh temp working dir per run — agents must never write into evals/fixtures/ source). Baseline: same prompt WITHOUT the skill, for eval 1 and eval 2 (highest-signal differentiators). Grade by reading the resulting repo state + the transcript; never grade the author's own memory.

Failable-verifier rule (enforced): each fixture's package.json scripts actually execute via node. `npm run test` exits non-zero when no tests/*.test.js exist (an empty suite is red) and when an authored test fails. `npm run meaningfulness` is the OBJECTIVE meaningfulness proof: it runs the authored test against the fixed collaborator/policy (expects GREEN) and against the seeded broken variant (expects RED), then restores the fixed version via try/finally. A vacant test (one that passes on the broken variant too) fails the check. Eval 1 (rls-seam) additionally enforces the no-service-role-bypass discipline: the verifier fails any test that passes `serviceRole: true`, because asserting isolation through a service-role bypass mocks away the security behaviour under test. Eval 2 (outbox-replay) seeds a broken outbox that drops all but the first queued mutation — a correct replay-all-in-order test goes red on it.

De-mirroring (learned from the writing-unit-tests round-1 fix, propagated to this skill): the skill body must NOT name the eval scenarios' specific tokens in its examples. The body's right-layer and brittleness examples use generic phrasing (a different seam, a different implementation detail) so the evals test generalization, not pattern-matching. Instructions must not give away eval answers (meta-skill rule).

Mid-session-install: a subagent launched right after `./install.sh` sometimes reports the `skill` tool does not list `writing-integration-tests` yet (registry snapshot timing). Install the skill >=1 prompt-render cycle before grading, OR instruct the subagent to load the skill file by explicit path (skills/writing-integration-tests/SKILL.md) as a fallback — the sibling skills' eval loops hit this same timing issue.

Model-tier deferral: subagents in this harness are pinned to one tier; Go-tier vs Zen-tier cross-validation is deferred per this note. Re-run the with-skill set across both tiers when the harness allows. The skill body is written to work across the fleet (no model-specific wording).

Right-layer routing (eval 3) is graded from the transcript: the observable is that the agent names the sibling skill writing-unit-tests and refuses to write an integration test that mocks a pure function's non-existent seam. The fixture provides context files only.
